prompt:
Create one coherent eight-cel animation of the exact approved illustrated secretary. Image 1 is her original detailed character master. Image 2 is the user-approved OPEN-EYED idle character. Image 3 supplies the approved OPEN-EYED seated writing posture, stool, open notebook, hands and fine painted material. Image 4 is an EMPTY four-column two-row layout guide. Keep this same person, broad rounded bob, full gentle cheeks, gray-olive eyes, compact torso and legs, gold clip, brown-gold uniform, cream skirt and stockings throughout. No redesign.

Her eyes stay gently OPEN in every cel, including when she looks down at the notebook: show visible dark irises lowered toward the paper, with visible whites/eye opening, not two closed eyelid lines. There is no blink in this action. Do not draw sleepy or closed eyes. The fifth cel must have clear relaxed warm open-eyed eye contact with the viewer. This is caring attention, without suspicious side-eye, eyebrow raising, surprise or a coy look.

She sits in the same three-quarter writing posture as image 3, with the open cream-page notebook on her lap. Small connected pen movements through hand/wrist/forearm while writing. The supporting hand, notebook, stool and feet remain anchored. Head tilt changes only a little and gradually; the eyes do most of the transition.

Eight consecutive cels in reading order: 1 open eyes directed down toward the paper, pen at start of a stroke; 2 same open downward eyes, complete the short stroke; 3 pen pauses, open gaze still on paper; 4 gaze lifts halfway, eyelids OPEN; 5 warm gentle open-eyed look at the viewer with a small natural smile; 6 gaze starts returning to paper, eyes OPEN; 7 open downward gaze, nib lowers; 8 same open downward gaze and writing posture as cel1. The loop closes without changing head position or body scale.

Output one large SQUARE sheet, four columns and two rows, exactly eight complete separated full-body cels including complete stool and shoes, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Identical scale and shoe baseline within each row, generous empty margins. Flat pure cyan #00FFFF background and chair openings. No shadow, floor, glow, scenery, grid, labels or effects. Preserve original delicate hair highlights, fine line work, cloth texture and soft painterly shading. All eight cels form one coherent family; no whole-art rocking or detached limbs.
method: Built-in imagegen, one coherent eight-cel sheet; whole-body scale and lower-body registration; no limb warping
review: Production visual review checked character identity, connected limbs and props, and loop continuity; intermediate review reports are retained locally.
generationSource: One coherent eight-cel sheet generated during artwork production; the intermediate sheet is not distributed. The exported PNG cels and playback sequence are stored beside this record.
